title: Claude Code tracing setup: async WAL trace export is on by default; only an explicit MLFLOW_ENABLE_ASYNC_TRACE_LOGGING value overrides it
answers: Why are Claude Code traces no longer blocking the Stop hook or getting lost when the backend upload fails?
How do I turn off async trace logging for Claude Code tracing?
Where is the Claude Code tracing environment defaulting handled?
Does async trace logging also change the default for other TypeScript SDK users?
body:
Path: Claude Code tracing startup, reached through libs/typescript/integrations/claude-code/src/config.ts:ensureInitialized, which reads the MLFLOW_CLAUDE_TRACING_ENABLED, tracking URI, experiment and workspace settings before any Stop-hook trace is exported.
Rule: ensureInitialized sets process.env[MLFLOW_ENABLE_ASYNC_TRACE_LOGGING] with ??= 'true' (constant defined in config.ts). Unset means the TypeScript SDK's existing WAL-backed async export path is used; an explicit 'false' or 'true' is left untouched. Do not change the SDK-wide default for this; the override is scoped to the Claude Code integration.
Constraints: Applies only when the Claude Code integration initializes. The assignment sits before the tracking-URI check, so it runs only on paths that reach that point. It does not add retry, logging or persistence logic; delivery retries are handled by the SDK's background daemon.
applies: Claude Code integration startup and its env-var defaults; not the generic TypeScript SDK default.
says: Claude Code tracing exports traces in the background; how do I turn that off?
Claude Code traces stop blocking the Stop hook; can I opt out of async logging?
Async trace logging defaults on for Claude Code only; explicit setting overrides it.
search: Claude Code integration sets async WAL trace logging on by default at startup via a ??= default for the async trace logging env variable. An explicit true or false value is respected. The SDK-wide default must not change, and the override is limited to the Claude Code integration. It adds no retry or persistence logic.
